WITH due AS (
  SELECT id, titulo, prazo, cobranca_count, criada_em,
    CASE
      WHEN prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'atrasada'
      WHEN prazo IS NOT NULL AND prazo = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'hoje'
      ELSE 'normal'
    END AS urgencia
  FROM giulia_tarefas
  WHERE status = 'pendente'
    AND (proxima_cobranca_em IS NULL OR proxima_cobranca_em <= NOW())
  ORDER BY (prazo IS NULL), prazo ASC, criada_em ASC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM due;
